three-matches.reason: Three successes are odd and exceed exactly one.

two-matches.reason: Two successes are even and exceed exactly one.

one-match.reason: A single success satisfies both groups. Negation of ONE makes the conjunction false.

zero-matches.reason: Zero successes are even and insufficient for ONE.

scope: The complete known Boolean subdomain. Unknown, error, not applicable and short-circuit trace behavior need separate qualification.
